gm_text: Rain spatters against the soot-dark stone of Cinderwatch's eastern gate, where frayed banners flutter wearily overhead. In this muddy gate district, the choke point hums with tension as refugees, wagons, and travelers jostle against the vigilant guards who hold firm, eyes sharp and wary. Nearby, a well-appointed townhouse bearing noble colors stands in quiet contrast to the clamorous, muddied square below. A ragged stranger in threadbare clothes stands still, their gaze flickering suspiciously between the passing faces and the piles of packs. Alongside the gate, a tavern runner shouts offers of hot stew and whispered rumors, weaving deftly through the pressing crowd. On a weathered notice board, fresh listings announce new taxes and curfews, alongside a warning about a missing patrol—a sign of unease that ripples through the gathered travelers and watchful sentries alike.
